title: POTV Cooling Dimpled Glass Stem
description:
Even cooler vapor

This glass stem comes with internal glass dimples for even cooler vapor for a variety of popular vaporizers (see compatibility below). As you inhale, the vapor travels through this gauntlet of dimples to cool and refine the vapor before it reaches your lips.

Low-profile

The Dimpled Stem provides a cooler experience without sacrificing the original shape or size. It holds the same shape and length as the original straight glass stem, but the key difference lies inside.

Now available in three new color options!

White Jade: Step into an aura of elegance with the White Jade color option.

Fluorescent: Ignite your senses (but not your herbs) with our vibrant and lively Fluorescent glass.

Navy Blue: Dive into a deep, serene ocean or stare at a starry night sky with this rich Navy Blue shade.

Compatibility

The Dimpled Glass Stem is compatible with:

Planet of the Vapes Lobo

Planet of the Vapes ONE

POTV XMAX V3 Pro

POTV Glass Adapter for V3 Pro

PAX Glass Adapter

Mighty+ Glass Adapter

Crafty+ Glass Adapter

Volcano Glass Adapter

Return policy

We only accept returns for accessories if they are within 30 days, unused and unopened, or if they are being returned with a vaporizer under our 14-day satisfaction policy.
